finding.summary: Postal upstream currently emits X-Postal-Signature using legacy SHA-1 and X-Postal-Signature-256 using SHA-256. UberBond's route supplied the legacy header to a SHA-256 verifier, which would quarantine authentic Postal webhooks and prevent reliable uncertain-effect reconciliation.

upstreamEvidence.fact: X-Postal-Signature uses sha1_sign64; X-Postal-Signature-256 uses sign64.

changes: api/webhooks/postal.mjs now supplies only x-postal-signature-256 to the SHA-256 verifier.
tests/postal-webhook-route.test.mjs proves a valid legacy SHA-1 header alone cannot authenticate, a valid SHA-256 header can, and a valid legacy header cannot rescue an invalid SHA-256 header.
tests/postal-ragnarok-mutation-source-guard.test.mjs prevents regression to x-postal-signature for SHA-256 verification.
